## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- CADDieDesignEngine — blanking / piercing die + punch clearance
- blank: die = part + 2*clearance; punch = part (10mm part, 2mm thick, 5%/side)
- pierce: die = hole; punch = hole - 2*clearance (8mm hole, 2mm thick, 5%/side)
- blank: 20mm part, 1mm thick, 10%/side -> clearance 0.1, die 20.2
- pierce: 5mm hole, 3mm thick, 8%/side -> clearance 0.24, punch 4.52
- blank: emits a die-opening rect op

## How to run

```bash
cd mcp-server && npx vitest run src/__tests__/CADDieDesignEngine.test.ts
```
